∀ {n : Nat} {adj : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Int},
  Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n adj →
    ∀ (α : Fin n → Int),
      Etingof.IsPositiveRoot n adj α →
        ∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] [Q : Quiver.{0, 0} (Fin n)],
          Etingof.IsOrientationOf.{0} Q adj →
            ∀ [∀ (a b : Fin n), Subsingleton.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b)],
              Exists.{u + 2} fun Vα =>
                And (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u, 0, 0, u} Vα)
                  (And (∀ (v : Fin n), Eq.{1} (Nat.cast.{0} (Etingof.Problem6_9_3.dimVec.{u, 0, 0, u} Vα v)) (α v))
                    (Exists.{u + 1} fun s =>
                      ∀ (i : Fin n),
                        Eq.{1} (Nat.cast.{0} (Etingof.QuiverRepCompositionSeries.mult.{u, 0, 0, u} s i)) (α i)))

∀ {k : Type u_1} {Q : Type u_2} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Quiver.{u_4, u_2} Q] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{u_2 + 1} Q]
  (Vα : Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} k Q) (n : Nat) (order : Equiv.{u_2 + 1, 1} Q (Fin n)),
  (∀ {v w : Q} (a : Quiver.Hom.{u_4, u_2} v w),
      LT.lt.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, 1} order w).val (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, 1} order v).val) →
    ∀ (α : Q → Nat)
      (basis :
        (v : Q) →
          Module.Basis.{0, u_1, u_3} (Fin (α v)) k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} Vα v)),
      Exists.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} fun s =>
        And
          (Eq.{1} (Etingof.QuiverRepCompositionSeries.length.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_3} s)
            (Finset.sum.{0, 0} Finset.univ.{0} fun l =>
              α (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, 1, u_2 + 1} (Equiv.symm.{u_2 + 1, 1} order) l)))
          (∀ (i : Q),
            Eq.{1} (Etingof.QuiverRepCompositionSeries.mult.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_3} s i)
              (Etingof.Problem6_9_3.dimVec.{u_1, u_2, u_4, u_3} Vα i))

  (∀ {v w : Q} (a : Quiver.Hom.{u_4, u_2} v w),

              d (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, 1, u_2 + 1} (Equiv.symm.{u_2 + 1, 1} e) l)))
